message:
Fix AI reliability bugs + email system overhaul

Email:
- Replace all nodemailer/Gmail SMTP with Resend HTTP API
  (Gmail ports 465/587 are blocked on Render free tier IPs)
- sendReceiptEmail, sendPlanWelcomeEmail, sendWelcomeEmail,
  notify-policy-update all now use sendResendEmail() helper

AI reliability:
- res.on('end'): parse finishReason from trailing SSE buffer so
  MAX_TOKENS in the last packet triggers continuation correctly
- Add ctx.serviceUnavailable flag for 503; plug it into retry loop
  so transient Gemini outages retry with 2s delay (same as 429)
- Each tier model alias gets its own array copy so workingModels
  cache tier-detection works correctly

UX:
- Mid-stream AI error: show error note in partial reply bubble
  instead of silently dropping it (gotFirst=true in app.js)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
